algorithm.name: water_mask (inland, band-group broadband + short/long index)
algorithm.description: Two-criterion threshold mask (broadband darkness + visible-vs-SWIR-group index) over an EnMAP reflectance cube windowed to the locked AOI polygon, followed by connected-component speckle filtering. See pipeline/water_mask.py and docs/WATER_MASK.md for full derivation.
algorithm.reference: Not DesalGuard-main's pipeline/water_mask.py values (MNDWI/NIR coastal thresholds explicitly not reused) -- interface shape only carried over; docs/WATER_MASK.md section 1 explains why.
algorithm.units_out: boolean mask, True = candidate water/wet-core pixel
assumptions: EnMAP bands are stored in increasing-wavelength order (standard imaging-spectrometer convention; not independently verified against a wavelength table for this file, but indirectly supported by the AOI's own mean-spectrum shape -- see docs/WATER_MASK.md section 2).
Reflectance scale factor is 1/10000 (sourced from EnMAP-Box's own import documentation; neither GeoTIFF carries an embedded scale/offset tag).
The 6 nodata-carrying bands (130-135, 1-based) can be dropped without materially affecting the broad band-group means (each group spans ~72 bands; losing 6 from one group is a small perturbation).
limitations: Single date (2022-09-08 only); the 2024-04-24 scene could not be staged for pixel-level work (file size exceeds this environment's per-file cap) -- see docs/WATER_MASK.md section 8.
Single small AOI sample (84 pixels inside the locked polygon in this window).
Broad band GROUPS, not exact narrow MNDWI/NDWI bands, because the per-band wavelength table is not yet available (docs/WATER_MASK.md section 2).

Reflectance over wet-core pixels carries the Land_Mode water-vapor-retrieval limitation described in docs/WATER_MASK.md section 7 -- not corrected for here, only checked and found non-blocking for a threshold classification.
